versions.changelog: Narrow skill trigger description to reduce false positives. The skill now explicitly avoids routine implementation, debugging, refactoring, docs, design, and general review requests unless audit/risk/security/regression evidence is requested.
Remove non-ASCII trigger and eval text to avoid encoding issues. Skill content is now ASCII-only while preserving audit modes, reviewer routing, tests, and eval runner.
Initial release: intent-aligned code audit workflow with modes, independent reviewer routing, custom provider detection, audit packet builder, tests, and eval runner.
